tailoring.headline: Senior Architect & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Senior developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. Experienced in working across business and IT as a techno-functional consultant. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with hands-on expertise in enterprise software development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Architect - Syneos Health Careers
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Hybris Developer opening at Syneos Health Careers, bringing over 5 years of specialized software development experience building robust e-commerce platforms. Through my recent work at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have designed and delivered complex enterprise solutions using Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) and built optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure seamless enterprise data flow.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & Support
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories, and translate them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my technical expertise can support your engineering initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise software development and SAP Commerce expertise to Syneos Health Careers. Building scalable e-commerce solutions that drive business value motivates my work, and I am excited about the opportunity to apply my background in Java, Spring, and API integrations to your engineering initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java software development expertise to deliver robust, scalable e-commerce solutions for Syneos Health Careers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Chandra, I saw your posting for the Hybris Developer opening. With 5+ years of software development experience building enterprise SAP Commerce platforms using Java and Spring, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Architect / Hybris Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Chandra G,

I am writing to apply for the Hybris Developer opening at Syneos Health Careers. With over 5 years of software development experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and enterprise integrations, I bring a strong background in building and optimizing robust e-commerce platforms.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached to this email. I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
